notes.title: "Going to Town"-Achievement Fix
notes.content:
Hi bobo robot players! 

Just letting you know that I fixed the "Going to Town" achievement. It's supposed to give it to you once you reach the town, but I typed a capital C instead of a small c in the code accidentally! Oops. Now you can finally get the achievement, though.

Thanks for playing!

- rub
